images.title: (b − 6)² in a sign grid
images.purpose: Shows (b − 6)(b − 6) as a 2 by 2 multiplication grid, so both − 6b terms and the + 36 from (−6) × (−6) are seen.
images.composition: One 2 by 2 grid centred with the terms of each bracket along the top and left. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A 2 by 2 grid of square cells. Above the columns, the labels 'b' and '− 6'; to the left of the rows, the labels 'b' and '− 6'. Cells: top left teal (#0072B2) labelled 'b²'; top right vermilion (#D55E00) labelled '− 6b'; bottom left vermilion labelled '− 6b'; bottom right green (#009E73) labelled '+ 36'. Exactly 4 cells.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: (b − 6)² = b² − 12b + 36: minus times minus gives plus.
images.description: Shows (b − 6)(b − 6) as a 2 by 2 multiplication grid, so both − 6b terms and the + 36 from (−6) × (−6) are seen.

image_decisions.why: The grid shows both middle terms and the sign of the last term, where students slip.
